description: Which architecture-state finding codes a JSON Schema validator can express, and which only the native validator in bin/architecture/state.py can. `schema-and-native` codes must be rejected by BOTH; `native-only` codes are cross-object, uniqueness, ordering, or hashing invariants that draft-07 cannot state, so a fixture invalid only via one of them is legitimately schema-valid on its own. test_schema_conformance.py reads this file to decide which direction to assert.

excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_BAD_PROJECTION_TYPE: matcher caller-input validation: a candidate is planning state a caller passes in, never a persisted document, so no JSON Schema governs it.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_BAD_SIGNAL: matcher caller-input validation: signal fields are validated at the call boundary, not on disk.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_DUPLICATE_KEY: matcher caller-input validation: uniqueness across the candidate list passed to match(), which is not a document.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_MALFORMED_KEY: matcher caller-input validation: candidate keys are per-run planning joins, never persisted state.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_MISSING_FIELD: matcher caller-input validation: enforces CANDIDATE_REQUIRED at the call boundary.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_NOT_AN_OBJECT: matcher caller-input validation: shape of an argument, not of a stored object.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_CANDIDATE_UNKNOWN_FIELD: matcher caller-input validation: the hard abort that refuses provider-specific fields rather than ignoring them.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_BAD_ORDER: matcher caller-input validation: thresholds arrive as an argument; config.thresholds itself is covered by E_ARCH_CONFIG_BAD_THRESHOLDS.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_BAD_VALUE: matcher caller-input validation: same argument-boundary check as above.
excluded_codes.E_ARCH_THRESHOLDS_OUT_OF_RANGE: matcher caller-input validation: same argument-boundary check as above.
